title: Sparks of Rationality: Do Reasoning LLMs Align with Human Judgment and Choice?
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmarks focus on evaluating LLMs on core axioms of rational choice and classic decision domains from behavioral economics, such as risk seeking, ambiguity aversion, loss aversion, and moral judgment, under different emotional states.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith.
